text: $BMT surged 67.5% to $0.039, trading in a tight $0.021-$0.051 range and pulling in over $53.9M in quote volume. $ERA also climbed, up about 20.5% to $0.0876, with a high of $0.1031 and $27.2M flowing through. Looks like the meme-coin rally isn't spilling over to the broader market right now.

In short, ETH's got relative strength, BTC's lagging, and the broader alt set is nudging ahead of the king. Nothing wild, just a modest shift in the hierarchy.
